about:
# Wave Fix

Fixes inaccurate wave angles and floating-point errors using trajectory projection.

Now you can enjoy the perfect 45-degree wave and ~63.4349488229...-degree mini wave, also known as arctan(2)!

Watch this [YouTube Short](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/dgpG8RsWSmQ) by gmdblue.

Shoutout to Daily Dose of Geometry Dash [YouTube Short](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/DzdDlnWaAi0) for mentioning the controversy.

---

## IMPORTANT

- This mod is considered **CHEATING** on most lists (Like AREDL and Pointercrate)
- This mod may **BREAK** bots or macros
- Does **NOT** correct sideways (Arrow trigger) wave movements
- Works well with the Click Between Frames mod
- Does not cause music desync
- Any frame extrapolation mods can make the camera jittery when locked to the player

*In my humble opinion*, you can use it daily but turn it off for completions.

Use the bug report and feedback channel in my Discord server!

---

## Fun Fact

- The wave being exactly 44.9 and 45.1 degrees is a misconception, it actually depends on the player's position.
- Due to floating-point errors, if you go far enough on the X or Y axis, it can become super off or not move at all!
- You may think the mod is unnoticeable, but it actually helps on longer levels (and having really weird click patterns).

The more you know...
